member.name: T:Company.CMDPilot.PowerShell.PowerShellAstAnalyzer
member.summary: Provides capabilities to parse and analyze PowerShell scripts using its native AST.

member.name: M:Company.CMDPilot.PowerShell.PowerShellAstAnalyzer.ExtractCommands(System.String)
member.summary: Analyzes the provided script text and extracts the names of commands invoked.
member.returns: A list of command names found in the script.

member.name: M:Company.CMDPilot.PowerShell.PowerShellAstAnalyzer.DetectObfuscation(System.String)
member.summary: Detects potentially obfuscated or dangerous syntax, such as dynamic invocation ('&' operator with variables).
member.returns: True if obfuscation patterns are detected; otherwise, false.
